tours.title: Barcelona 9 Days: Gaudí, Old Town & the Mediterranean
tours.overview: Barcelona is a lively Mediterranean city where historic streets, modern architecture, golden beaches and world-famous food come together. From the extraordinary designs of Antoni Gaudí to the atmosphere of the Gothic Quarter and the waterfront, this journey offers a rich introduction to the Catalan capital and its surroundings.

snapshot.label: Accommodation
snapshot.value: 8 nights in a selected 3-star category hotel (or similar) in Barcelona, with daily breakfast

itinerary.title: Arrival in Barcelona
itinerary.body: Arrive at Barcelona–El Prat Airport, meet the local representative and transfer to the hotel. Check in and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Barcelona.

itinerary.title: Sagrada Família & Gaudí avenues
itinerary.body: Visit the Sagrada Família (timed entry recommended), then explore Passeig de Gràcia and admire Casa Batlló and Casa Milà from outside or with optional entry. Overnight in Barcelona.

itinerary.title: Park Güell & Gràcia
itinerary.body: Discover Park Güell and its colourful mosaics and city viewpoints. Continue to the Gràcia neighbourhood for its relaxed squares, cafés and local atmosphere. Overnight in Barcelona.

itinerary.title: Gothic Quarter & La Rambla
itinerary.body: Walk through the Gothic Quarter, visit the Barcelona Cathedral area, stroll along La Rambla and explore La Boqueria Market. Enjoy free time in the city centre. Overnight in Barcelona.

itinerary.title: Barceloneta & waterfront
itinerary.body: Spend time at Barceloneta Beach and explore Port Vell and the waterfront promenade. Optional harbour activities or a relaxed seaside lunch can be arranged. Overnight in Barcelona.

itinerary.title: Montjuïc & city panoramas
itinerary.body: Explore Montjuïc's viewpoints, gardens and cultural landmarks. Optional cable car or museum visits can be added subject to operating hours and tickets. Overnight in Barcelona.

itinerary.title: Optional Montserrat excursion
itinerary.body: Enjoy an optional day trip to Montserrat, a dramatic mountain retreat known for its unusual rock formations and Benedictine monastery. Transport, monastery access and any activities depend on the selected excursion. Overnight in Barcelona.

itinerary.title: Leisure, shopping & local flavours
itinerary.body: Enjoy a flexible day for shopping, museums, neighbourhood cafés or revisiting favourite places. Consider sampling Catalan cuisine and exploring areas at your own pace. Overnight in Barcelona.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Barcelona Airport for your return journey.

tours.title: Da Nang 5 Days: Ba Na Hills, Golden Bridge & Hoi An
tours.overview: Experience Vietnam's coastal charm, cultural heritage and natural wonders. Explore the iconic Golden Bridge at Ba Na Hills, enjoy a traditional basket boat ride and wander through the charming streets of Hoi An Ancient Town.

snapshot.label: Accommodation
snapshot.value: 3-star category hotel – Anfada Danang or similar

snapshot.label: Transport
snapshot.value: Airport and sightseeing transfers by air-conditioned vehicle

highlights: Golden Bridge at Ba Na Hills

itinerary.title: Da Nang arrival
itinerary.body: Arrive at Da Nang Airport, meet our guide and transfer to the hotel. Check in and enjoy an overnight stay in Da Nang.

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge
itinerary.body: After breakfast at the hotel, enjoy a full-day excursion to Ba Na Hills, including a cable car ride, the iconic Golden Bridge, panoramic mountain views, Linh Ung Pagoda, gardens and Fantasy Park. Return to Da Nang for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Da Nang city tour, basket boat ride & Hoi An
itinerary.body: After breakfast, visit Son Tra Peninsula and Lady Buddha, followed by a basket boat ride at Cam Thanh Coconut Village. Continue to Hoi An Ancient Town to explore its historic streets, Japanese Covered Bridge and traditional architecture. Return to Da Nang for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day at leisure
itinerary.body: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Spend the day at leisure exploring Da Nang, relaxing at the beach or shopping on your own. Overnight in Da Nang.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Da Nang Airport for your return journey to Kathmandu.

tours.title: London 10 Days: Royal Heritage, Windsor, Bath & Oxford
tours.overview: From the famous clock tower of Big Ben and the royal splendour of Buckingham Palace to the historic Tower of London and the lively River Thames, London brings together centuries of history with modern city life. This 10-day holiday also introduces you to beautiful English destinations beyond the capital.

snapshot.label: Accommodation
snapshot.value: 9 nights at a selected 3-star category hotel in London (or similar), with daily breakfast

itinerary.title: Arrival in London
itinerary.body: Airport arrival, transfer to the hotel, check-in and time to relax.

itinerary.title: Westminster & royal London
itinerary.body: Big Ben, Houses of Parliament, Westminster area, Buckingham Palace and St James's Park.

itinerary.title: Tower of London & Tower Bridge
itinerary.body: Explore the historic fortress area, admire Tower Bridge and enjoy riverside views.

itinerary.title: South Bank & museums
itinerary.body: London Eye area, British Museum and central London neighbourhoods.

itinerary.title: Windsor
itinerary.body: Day excursion to Windsor town and Windsor Castle, subject to access and ticket availability.

itinerary.title: Stonehenge & Bath
itinerary.body: Discover the prehistoric stone circle and the historic city of Bath.

itinerary.title: Oxford
itinerary.body: Explore Oxford's university city, architecture and historic streets.

itinerary.title: Greenwich
itinerary.body: Discover Greenwich's maritime heritage, parkland and Prime Meridian area.

itinerary.title: Leisure & shopping
itinerary.body: Free day for shopping, museums, theatre or independent exploration.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: Breakfast, hotel check-out and transfer to the airport.

tours.title: Switzerland 4 Days: Zurich, Lucerne & Interlaken
tours.overview: Switzerland is famous for its dramatic Alpine peaks, clear blue lakes, scenic rail journeys and beautifully preserved towns. This short escape introduces you to Zurich's lively city atmosphere, Lucerne's lakeside charm and the spectacular mountain scenery around Interlaken.

snapshot.label: Accommodation
snapshot.value: 3 nights in selected 3-star category hotels (or similar). Suggested split: 1 night Zurich, 1 night Lucerne and 1 night Interlaken

snapshot.label: Transport
snapshot.value: Travel between cities may be arranged by Swiss rail or private vehicle

highlights: Jungfraujoch – Top of Europe (optional / subject to availability)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich
itinerary.body: Arrive at Zurich Airport and transfer to the hotel. After check-in, enjoy a relaxed city orientation, with time to explore Zurich Old Town, Bahnhofstrasse and the Lake Zurich waterfront. Overnight in Zurich.

itinerary.title: Zurich to Lucerne
itinerary.body: After breakfast, travel to Lucerne by train or private transfer. Explore Chapel Bridge, the Water Tower, Old Town and the lakeside promenade. Optional Lake Lucerne cruise or Mount Pilatus / Mount Titlis excursion can be arranged subject to time and availability. Overnight in Lucerne or nearby.

itinerary.title: Lucerne to Interlaken
itinerary.body: Travel through the Swiss countryside to Interlaken. Enjoy the town centre and views of the surrounding mountains and lakes. Optional Jungfraujoch excursion or Lauterbrunnen Valley visit may be arranged depending on the selected package, weather and railway operations. Overnight in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: After breakfast, check out and transfer by train or private vehicle to Zurich Airport for your return flight. Departure transfer timing should be planned around the confirmed flight schedule.

tours.title: Sydney 6 Days: Harbour, Bondi, Taronga & the Blue Mountains
tours.overview: Sydney is Australia's iconic harbour city, celebrated for its striking waterfront, famous architecture, beautiful beaches and relaxed outdoor lifestyle. This six-day holiday combines the city's signature landmarks with coastal scenery, Australian wildlife and a day exploring the spectacular Blue Mountains.

snapshot.label: Accommodation
snapshot.value: 5 nights in a selected 3-star category hotel (or similar) in Sydney, with daily breakfast

itinerary.title: Arrival in Sydney
itinerary.body: Arrive at Sydney Airport, meet the local representative and transfer to the hotel. Check in and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Sydney city & harbour tour
itinerary.body: Explore the Sydney Opera House precinct, Harbour Bridge viewpoints, Circular Quay and The Rocks. Continue to Darling Harbour and enjoy time by the waterfront. Optional Opera House guided tour can be arranged subject to availability. Overnight in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Bondi Beach & coastal experience
itinerary.body: Visit Bondi Beach and enjoy time for photographs, relaxation and a section of the scenic coastal walk. Explore nearby coastal viewpoints and cafés before returning to the city. Overnight in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Taronga Zoo & harbour views
itinerary.body: Visit Taronga Zoo to discover Australian and international wildlife. Enjoy the harbour setting and, if included in the confirmed plan, travel by ferry for scenic city views. Overnight in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Blue Mountains excursion
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring the Blue Mountains, including Echo Point and the Three Sisters. Optional Scenic World rides or a visit to a mountain village may be included depending on the selected excursion. Return to Sydney. Overnight in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Sydney Airport for your return journey.

tours.title: Thailand 5 Days: Bangkok, Pattaya & Coral Island
tours.overview: Explore the vibrant city of Bangkok and the lively beach resort of Pattaya. Discover ornate temples, exciting wildlife attractions, turquoise island waters and the famous Coral Island.

snapshot.label: Accommodation
snapshot.value: 3-star category hotels in Bangkok and Pattaya (or similar)

snapshot.label: Transport
snapshot.value: Airport and intercity transfers by air-conditioned vehicle

itinerary.title: Bangkok arrival
itinerary.body: Arrive at Bangkok Airport, meet the local representative and transfer to the hotel. Check in and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Bangkok city tour
itinerary.body: After breakfast, explore Bangkok's cultural highlights, including the Grand Palace area and Wat Pho (Reclining Buddha), subject to opening hours and local arrangements. Enjoy free time for shopping or exploring the city. Overnight in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Safari World & transfer to Pattaya
itinerary.body: After breakfast, visit Safari World for an exciting day among its wildlife attractions and scheduled shows. Later, transfer to Pattaya and check in at the hotel. Overnight in Pattaya.

itinerary.title: Coral Island & Pattaya
itinerary.body: After breakfast, enjoy a speedboat excursion to Coral Island (Koh Larn), with time to relax on the beach or enjoy optional water activities at your own expense. Return to Pattaya. Overnight in Pattaya.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: After breakfast, check out and transfer from Pattaya to Bangkok Airport for your return journey.

tours.title: Turkey 6 Days: Istanbul & Cappadocia
tours.overview: Discover the fascinating blend of history, culture and natural beauty in Turkey. Explore Istanbul's magnificent mosques and lively bazaars, cruise along the Bosphorus and experience the extraordinary landscapes of Cappadocia, famous for its fairy chimneys and hot-air balloons.

snapshot.label: Accommodation
snapshot.value: 5 nights in selected 3-star category hotels (or similar): suggested split of 3 nights in Istanbul and 2 nights in Cappadocia

snapshot.label: Transport
snapshot.value: Domestic flights Istanbul–Cappadocia–Istanbul only if stated in the confirmed quotation

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.body: Arrive at Istanbul Airport, meet the local representative and transfer to the hotel. Check in and enjoy the evening at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul city tour
itinerary.body: Discover the city's historic highlights, including Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque area, Topkapi Palace and the Grand Bazaar. Sight visits depend on opening hours and the final tour plan. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus cruise & travel to Cappadocia
itinerary.body: Enjoy a scenic Bosphorus cruise, then transfer to the airport for your domestic flight to Cappadocia. On arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia tour
itinerary.body: Explore the region's fairy chimneys, valleys, Göreme area and an underground city. Optional sunrise hot-air balloon flight may be arranged separately, subject to weather and availability. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia to Istanbul
itinerary.body: Enjoy breakfast and some free time, subject to flight timing. Transfer to the airport for your domestic flight back to Istanbul. Transfer to the hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Istanbul Airport for your return journey.
